diagnostic: diagnostic_threshold_D_native.npz = threshold-only ablation with exact stochastic-input pairing to E; never label this no-core

metadata_correction: D: independent Poisson at nu throughout; E: unchanged local max(0.95*nu+OU,0) Poisson patch and deterministic exterior. D/E are different working regimes, not a one-factor causal test.
pairing_boundary: D has independent Poisson input globally; E retains its original local OU/Poisson patch. No identical external spike stream between D and E.
selection: Pre-existing K=1 physical canary, before inspecting its long response; no search.
contrast: Homogeneous noisy background vs localized one-core bursting regime; not an exactly input-paired core ablation.
